span.p: Yes

span.p: Benefits only this award

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Benefits several awards / activities

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: Benefits NO grant activity

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: No

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: Yes

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: Direct

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: Indirect

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: Negotiated rate

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: De-minimis (10% MTDC)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: A cost is about to be charged to the grant

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Is it ALLOWABLE?
permitted by 2 CFR 200 cost principles
AND not barred by this award's terms
(no excluded category, e.g. lobbying, alcohol, fines)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
DO NOT CHARGE the grant
pay from unrestricted funds if the org still wants the cost
charging an unallowable cost is a disallowed-cost / repayment risk

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Is it ALLOCABLE?
does it benefit THIS award,
in proportion to the benefit received?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Is it REASONABLE?
would a prudent person incur it,
at this amount, in these circumstances?
(market price; arms-length; necessary)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
ALLOCATE by a documented, consistent basis
charge each award only its proportional share
(e.g. time-and-effort for split salaries)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
DO NOT CHARGE the grant
not allocable = not a grant cost

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
DO NOT CHARGE the grant
document why if a variance looks high
unreasonable cost = disallowed-cost risk

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Is it DIRECT or INDIRECT?
direct = identifiable to this award/program
indirect (F&A) = shared org-wide cost

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
CHARGE to the correct DIRECT budget line
keep the source document (invoice/timesheet/receipt)
tie it to the approved budget category

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Do you have a negotiated indirect-cost
rate (NICRA) or are you using
the 10% de-minimis rate?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
APPLY the negotiated rate to the correct base
do not double-charge a cost as both direct and indirect

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
APPLY 10% de minimis of modified total direct costs
verify the award allows it and the rate/percentage
[verify-at-use 2026-06-22 — de-minimis % has changed by amendment]
